Class TemporalEdge

java.lang.Object
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Edge
edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.TemporalEdge
All Implemented Interfaces:
Commented, Consenting, Comparable<TemporalEdge>
public class TemporalEdge extends Edge implements Comparable<TemporalEdge>, Consenting
A temporal edge models how the state of a node changes after an action occurs. The tail node is the state before the action occurs. The label is the action. The head node is the state after the action occurs.

New temporal edges should be created in a story graph using the TemporalEdgeList.add(Node, Action, Node) method.

Author:
Stephen G. Ware
